title: Fix non-functional Admin/Settings navigation and correct Callaway chart defaults

requirements.text: Fix routing so the Header "Settings" button navigates to and renders the Settings screen, and the Settings screen "Back" button returns to the main scoring flow.

quotes: the admin and settings buttons do not work, the Callaway Chart values are incorrect

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Header "Settings" button changes the URL to /settings and the Settings UI is visible (not the main scoring-step UI).
Clicking "Back" on the Settings screen returns to / and shows the main scoring-step UI again.
Navigation uses the existing TanStack Router setup (no full page refresh).

requirements.text: Fix routing so the Header "Admin" button (when admin access is enabled) navigates to and renders the Admin screen, including correct "Back" and "Open Settings" navigation behaviors.

quotes: the admin and settings buttons do not work, the Callaway Chart values are incorrect

acceptanceCriteria: When Admin Access is enabled in Settings, the Header shows an "Admin" button.
Clicking the Header "Admin" button changes the URL to /admin and the Admin UI is visible (not the main scoring-step UI).
On /admin, clicking "Back" returns to / and shows the main scoring-step UI.
On /admin, clicking "Open Settings" navigates to /settings and shows the Settings UI.
When Admin Access is disabled, visiting /admin shows the existing access-disabled message and the "Open Settings" button navigates to /settings.

requirements.text: Correct the shipped/default Callaway Chart values used by the app so calculations and the displayed chart match the documented/legacy Callaway chart defaults for both 9-hole and 18-hole rounds.

quotes: the admin and settings buttons do not work, the Callaway Chart values are incorrect

acceptanceCriteria: For 18 holes, the displayed Callaway chart matches these ranges/values: 70-75→worst holes 0 adj 0; 76-80→1 adj 0; 81-85→2 adj 0; 86-90→2 adj 0; 91-95→3 adj 0; 96-100→3 adj 0; 101-105→4 adj 0; 106-110→4 adj -2; 111-115→5 adj -2; 116-120→5 adj -2; 121-125→6 adj -2; 126-130→6 adj -2; 131-135→7 adj -2; 136+→8 adj -2.
For 9 holes, the displayed Callaway chart matches these ranges/values: 35-39→worst holes 0 adj 0; 40-43→1 adj 0; 44-47→2 adj 0; 48-54→2 adj -1; 55-59→3 adj -1; 60+→4 adj -1.
Callaway net score calculations use the same corrected chart values as the chart displayed in the UI.

Any previously persisted invalid/old shipped defaults in localStorage do not continue to force incorrect chart values after this fix (users can still keep intentional custom edits made via the Admin chart editor).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook entrypoints listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
nonGoals: Adding new authentication providers or changing auth flows (Internet Identity only).
Adding real-time updates or websocket-based navigation/state sync.
Changing the Callaway scoring rules beyond correcting the chart default values and ensuring the UI uses them consistently.
